device_or_browser: Node.js v25.9.0 VM; browser APIs supplied by deterministic XHR/clock fixture
limitation: No physical old-browser or device qualification; shared asset packaging and application version bumps belong to parent integration.

acceptance.observation: A silent production XHR settles once at 4000 ms, aborts its transport and releases the request lane.
Native timeout and watchdog delivered in both orders produce one callback and leave zero timers.
Captured late success/error after cancellation cannot publish old data or clear the successor busy gate.
Production runtime executes without AbortController, Promise or fetch; a rejected native timeout setter is still bounded by the watchdog.

production_page_regression.observation: Actual call.html blackholed call-info previously kept loadPending non-null; the same assertion now passes at 4000 ms.

review_regression.observation: When state fails first, the owning load cancels its call-info handle. A retry recovers, rejected lane admission settles, and an old page finally cannot cancel the successor.
